doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

title: Opening: Mooney Martin's name, birth in Algiers 1896
summary: Russell opens the interview at Tom Albert's house on Burgundy Street. Martin gives his name, says Mooney is a nickname, and says he was born 24 November 1896 in Algiers' low coast near where George Lewis lives.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: This is Bill Russell speaking. We're interviewing Mr. Milton Martin. Is that your full name? Over at Tom Albert's house on Burgundy Street, where we used to interview Mr. Albert and Vess and other people were here the last time I was here. Can you give us your full name? Everybody calls you Mooney.
Milton Martin. How did you get that name of Mooney?
Just a nickname. That's a nickname. Can you tell us when you were born, if you don't mind, about how old you are?
1896. That's right. And what was the exact date?
24th of November. Where was that? On this side of the river or the other side?
Down, as they call it, down the low coast there. That's right. That was past the naval station.
Is it as far as the cutoff? There's a place I never did know just where the cutoff is.
